blurb: Guests meet before sunrise for a safety briefing and balloon inflation, then enjoy a flight lasting about 45 to 80 minutes. Flights include stunning views, local wildlife, and end with a post-flight champagne toast. Tethered rides are also available, rising 25 to 75 feet and lasting 2-3 hours at events.
